goal: S4/S5 reproducible local RH tarsal-clearance feasibility, no full teacher implementation or integration
sample_selection: Nearest saved1ms endpoint within.000501s, no new integration. Fixed8points include precontact/contactpeak/postcontact and another RH stance.
motor_target_note: Substitute only7RH motor target angles from saved TRACE.target into actual qpos; root and other35angles remain actual. These are motor-target geometry probes, never called q_des; target contains finite-PD/feedforward/rate effects.
static_only: After parent explicitly authorizes --run-static, instantiate unchanged baseline Core for compiled identity only. All tested poses copied to private MjData; root7 values remain bitexact saved actual root. Only mj_kinematics/mj_comPos/mj_jac/mj_geomDistance/mj_collision, no step/forward dynamics/contact force prediction. Core live data and model never modified by probe after construction.
geometry: Name-check compiled RHTarsus4_geom/body/floor and7RH actuator joints. Use compiled mesh_vert transformed by geom_xpos/xmat, floor worldnormal/point; signed minimum plane support independent of contact margin. Cross-check mj_geomDistance and shadow mj_collision distances/includemargin; report all RH nonfoot geom minima.
pad_task: Preserve original3D teacher primary task at each baseline pose: mean pad XY in thorax frame, lowest sphere bottom Z transformed to original settled initial-root frame (from saved1s pose). Current private root stays actual. This is baseline snapshot pad task, not reconstructed teacher q_des or replayed desired reference.
jacobians: SVD3x7 padJ rank using max(1e-12,smax*1e-9); nullbasis V[:,rank:], rank3 gives4null dims. Mesh active vertex attached-material-point analytic normal*mj_jac vs centered FD epsilon1e-6rad. Also report nonsmooth min-support/pad FD and active gaps; ties marked nondifferentiable, never hidden.
margin: Read actual compiled geom margin/gap and pair explicit overrides; effective solver inclusion margin taken from actual shadow floor/Tarsus4 contact.includemargin when present. No guessed combination or force prediction. Candidate h_safe=effective includemargin+.002native; if no contact at pose use verified same-pair margin learned from other fixed contact snapshots, otherwise unavailable/fail rather than silently assume.

bounded_secondary.algorithm: Small bounded local nullspace linear program/QP for ascent direction, then backtrack and nonlinear pad reprojection; each decision bounds intersect original joint limits and current±.005rad, cumulative bounds original±.1rad. No silent clipping or joint-limit changes. Fixed original pad target throughout sequence, nonlinear residual<=1e-5 each accepted step. Recompute all mesh minima; reject new/worsened geometric floor penetration by other RH nonfoot segments. Record individual step and at most20 private kinematic steps separately; these are not integration or actual teacher q_des. Report required cumulative angles and max_abs_delta/2rad_per_s time lower bound, not guaranteed tracking time. Single-step failure to reach h_safe is not infeasibility.

checks: Actual compiled identity, immutable inputs/model/liveCoredata/root/otherangles, geometry cross-check, attachedpoint FD, padJ SVD/null gZ, all bounded successful/failed attempts, nonlinear pad residual, otherRH geom heights/changes and geometric contact diagnostics. No changed slip/cycle/NF criteria or collision classification.
outputs: Exclusive RESULT_STATIC_PROBE_<UTC_pid_ns>.json and exclusive independent AUDIT_STATIC_PROBE_<UTC_pid_ns>.json in new root only. No old VERIFY/RESULT/source/tracker writes; exceptions retained in unique failed result. Reports include all16rows even failed local attempts when runtime identity remains valid.
resources: Parent controls start after unique heavy job releases; CPU1 and OPENBLAS/OMP/MKL1, no subagents/training/rendering/integration. Current preparation only stdlib AST/hash/default-entry checks, no numpy/scipy/MuJoCo/physics imports.
source_freeze: Strict one-time SOURCEHASH_STATIC_PROBE.json before any static execution; includes new executables/PREREG plus inherited actual identity/assets and saved evidence. Default entries CODEONLY/NOT_RUN; no automatic reanchoring.
scope: Local static geometry feasibility only. No full new teacher, native force prediction, dynamic safety, achieved walking or changed old strictNF FAIL claimed. Future teacher would need separate preregistration and full physical gates.
